specialEventConditions.title: Chritmas/New Year Policy
specialEventConditions.description: Please note that arrivals and departures are not permitted on 25th and 26th December 2025 or the 1st of January 2026. A 7 day cancellation policy applies between 20 December and 2 January; bookings will be fully charged 7 days prior to arrival and are non-refundable.

freeCancellation.label: Free Cancellation rates
freeCancellation.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 8th Nov 2025 (AEST) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 8th Nov 2025 (AEST) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.
